details.description: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct is an instruction-tuned, 7.61-billion-parameter text language model in Alibaba Cloud's Qwen2.5 series, released September 19, 2024. The model card describes gains over earlier Qwen models in coding and mathematics, instruction-following, generating long-form text, understanding structured data such as tables, and producing structured output such as JSON. Alibaba's Qwen GitHub organization now centers on the newer Qwen3 model family, though the Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct weights remain published on Hugging Face with no explicit deprecation notice on its model card.
advantages: Multilingual support for over 29 languages, including Chinese, English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Thai, and Arabic, per the model card.
The model card lists a full context length of 131,072 tokens (via YaRN scaling) with generation up to 8,192 tokens, versus a 32,768-token default configuration.
The model card states improved instruction-following and better understanding of structured data (e.g. tables) with structured output generation such as JSON, compared to earlier Qwen releases.
disadvantages: Text-only model with no image, audio, or video input support.
The model card does not publish exact benchmark scores (e.g. MMLU, GSM8K, HumanEval) in text form for this specific 7B size; detailed results are only shown as chart images in Qwen's blog post.
use_cases: General-purpose conversational assistant and instruction following
Long-document processing aided by extended context length
Structured data understanding and JSON/structured output generation

sources.title: Qwen2.5: A Party of Foundation Models!
QwenLM/Qwen2.5 (GitHub org repo, now retitled Qwen3)

notes: The model card's headline context length (131,072 tokens via YaRN, default config 32,768) differs from the catalog's max_input/max_output of 32768; the catalog's value is kept per instructions. The languages list is the explicit example set named on the model card ('including... and more'); the card does not give a closed list, so a small number of additional languages may exist beyond those named. No exact benchmark numbers (MMLU/GSM8K/HumanEval/etc.) for the 7B size were found in text form on the maker's model card, README, or blog post -- only aggregate chart images, which this agent could not read -- so evaluations is left empty rather than guessed. The github.com/QwenLM/Qwen2.5 repository now displays Qwen3 content (title 'Qwen3 Repository'), used only as evidence that Alibaba's primary GitHub project has moved to Qwen3; github_url is left null since there is no dedicated current repo for this model.
